description: This file is a PHP unit test class for the ResetPasswordDao component within the OrangeHRM authentication plugin. It tests functionalities such as saving a reset password request, retrieving reset password logs by reset code, and updating reset password validity.

classes.name: ResetPasswordDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the ResetPasswordDao methods related to password reset requests and logs.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, including instantiating the ResetPasswordDao, setting up fixtures, and mocking services.

methods.name: testSaveResetPassword
methods.description: Tests the saving of a reset password request and verifies the reset email and code.

methods.name: testGetResetPasswordLogByResetCode
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a reset password log entry by reset code and verifies the associated email.

methods.name: testUpdateResetPasswordValid
methods.description: Tests updating the validity status of a reset password request.
